units.name: Management Department
units.evidence: The official Operations and Supply Chain Management bachelor programme identifies the Management Department as host. Its substantive curriculum concerns inventory, logistics, quality, process improvement and supply chain strategy; the Management department page separately lists the programme.

units.name: School of Automation, Mechanical & Manufacturing Systems
units.evidence: The official Manufacturing Engineering Technology bachelor page explicitly identifies this school. Its production-system scope includes process design and analysis, planning, machine location, tool and part movement, sequencing and equipment selection across the total production process.

decisions.reason: The official department exists under this expanded name, but its listed accountancy, finance, computing, AI, information security and project management programmes do not establish a substantive Operations unit. Operations and Supply Chain Management belongs to the separate Management Department.

DA is not an expanded department label in the official business list. A Data Science and Analytics MS exists, but no official evidence establishes that this imported abbreviation identifies that programme or an Operations department.
